brief: a video for my restaurant showing our chef cooking the signature biryani

context.platform: Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts, 9:16, 30 s
context.audience: families and food lovers in the city

concept: Three generations of one recipe, sealed in a pot: the moment the dum is broken is the moment the family arrives.
plan_outline: 1. ECU · top · static · dark kitchen, one warm lamp · the dough seal of a handi pot cracked open, steam bursting up (2 s, the hook)
2. CU · eye · static · same kitchen · saffron milk poured over layered rice (3 s)
3. MCU · eye · push in · same kitchen · the chef, a man in his fifties in a white kurta, tastes and nods once (4 s)
4. ECU · eye · static · same kitchen · fried onions scattered over the top, slow motion (3 s)
5. MS · eye · track · dining room, evening · the pot carried through the room to a family table (4 s)
6. MCU · eye · static · family table · a grandmother smiles as the lid is lifted, steam across her face (4 s)
7. WS · high · static · family table · hands reach in from all sides, the table full (4 s)
8. End card (page) · logo, 'Since 1987 · Book a table' (3 s)
why: Open on the most desirable second (breaking the dum) instead of an exterior: food reels live or die on texture.
One warm practical light in the kitchen, low key: craft and heritage, not a fast-food look.
The chef's face appears once, at the emotional beat; hands are kept simple (pouring, scattering).
Hands reaching in the last wide are small in frame, where errors don't show.
